title: Connect request
text: Every hosting mode shares the start request. Engine-issued match codes contain four unambiguous characters, such as K7F2, and expire after ten minutes. An active human organization member binds one approval or denial directly to the code row, and polling delivers the credential once. Hosted start issues a four-character match code before organization choice. The first signed-in member read or resolve routes that code into the selected organization through machine_authorization.handoff, using its actual engine org_id. Only the active hosted service with an explicit org grant calls handoff. Routing the same request to the same org is idempotent; routing elsewhere refuses with the original org and requires a fresh terminal connection. Authenticated service polling avoids a shared proxy-address budget without changing public admission. Consumer source adoption is observed; deployed proof remains pending. The approval card groups machine identity, code, org and local expiry with its zone; the UTC instant stays on the time element.
